recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量中至大型細胞，胞質豐富呈灰藍色、核偏心、部分可見核旁淡染區（perinuclear hof），染色質較細緻，與旁邊的嗜中性球比較明顯較大；這些不成熟型態的漿細胞成群出現，符合漿細胞骨髓瘤（plasma cell myeloma）。
features: Numerous medium to large plasma cells occupying much of the field
Abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with eccentric round nuclei and focal perinuclear hof
Relatively fine to mildly clumped chromatin, suggesting immature (plasmablastic-leaning) forms
Variation in plasma cell size; occasional multinucleated or closely apposed nuclei
Scattered segmented neutrophils and bands for size comparison; red cells in background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Romanowsky stain) shows a markedly increased population of plasma cells, many present in clusters. The plasma cells are medium to large, with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm, eccentric round nuclei, focal perinuclear clearing, and chromatin that is finer than that of mature plasma cells, with variation in cell size. Background granulocytes appear morphologically unremarkable. The photograph is taken through the eyepiece with some focus limitation, so nucleoli are not reliably assessed. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma in the context of a reported 60% marrow plasma cells and a monoclonal paraprotein.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are small, mature, with clock-face chromatin, usually below 10% and polytypic on light chain studies, rather than sheets of large immature forms.
Plasmablastic lymphoma has larger blasts with central prominent nucleoli and scant cytoplasm, typically extramedullary, often EBER-positive and in immunocompromised patients.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P, not a monomorphous plasma cell population.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have folded nuclei, fine lacy chromatin and gray cytoplasm with vacuoles without a hof, and are nonspecific esterase-positive and CD138-negative.
